summary: Tested Organisation Structure feature: backend APIs (20/20 pass), frontend org page, dashboard filters, team insights filters, and staff portfolio badges. Fixed 3 critical bugs: missing useState declarations in Dashboard.js (orgFilter, orgStructure) and missing Building2 import in Layout.js. All features working after fixes.

bugs_fixed.issue: orgFilter is not defined - missing useState declaration for orgFilter and orgStructure
bugs_fixed.fix: Added: const [orgFilter, setOrgFilter] = useState({ setting_id: '', team_id: '' }) and const [orgStructure, setOrgStructure] = useState({ settings: [], unassigned_users: [] })

bugs_fixed.issue: user is not defined - useAuth() was not destructuring 'user'
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed const { getAuthConfig, API } to const { getAuthConfig, API, user }

bugs_fixed.issue: Building2 is not defined - icon imported from lucide-react was missing
bugs_fixed.fix: Added Building2 to lucide-react import statement

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js had 3 undeclared state variables causing ReferenceErrors - these are now fixed
Layout.js was missing Building2 lucide icon import - now fixed
